title: A6700 open gate, sensor side: 5952 x 3876 window from row 214 in modes 0x820/0x880/0x890/0x8c0/0x8d0, first stage 5976 x 3884 squeezed into the stock 4336 x 2438 front end, vertical sampling ratio 165/191

ported_from.how: the A7 IV's mechanism (taller window, Lrc squeeze, sampling ratio) with the window a contributor chose for the A6700 (work/contrib/a6700_v1.0), every byte derived again from the A6700's files with the FX30 port's tools

summary.aspect_note: the window is 5952:3876 = 1.5356, the 3840 x 2560 file 1.5: shown at 1:1 pixels the picture is 2.37 % too tall (a circle is that much higher than wide)

stored_record_note: RAM, filled by the camera at start-up from the tables (60 Hz table on NTSC, 50 Hz on PAL); records base = the drive-parameter object's +0x10 (0x25dabcc in the file's table map) + index x 0x170; the write level finds each record through the pointer chain and takes the variant all five hold
